name: UCO Bank
summary: UCO Bank provides various banking and financial services in India and internationally. The company's deposit products include current accounts, saving accounts, fixed deposits, recurring deposits, accounts in foreign currency, and fee collection accounts. It also offers agri, home, education, gold, personal, vehicle, and mortgage loans; finance to micro and small enterprises; working capital financing; term loans; infrastructure finance; and agriculture credit.
